events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Mick Jagger, the iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, was born on this day in 1943.

angles.name: Jagger's Enduring Energy
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still moving like Jagger! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary frontman, Sir Mick Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) officially launched on August 1, 1981, famously kicking off with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'.

angles.name: MTV Changed Everything
angles.copy: Forty-five years since MTV burst onto our screens, changing music and television forever. Remember the first video they played? Iconic!

events.title: Woodstock Festival began 57 years ago
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, an iconic three-day festival of 'Peace & Music', kicked off on August 15, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. A truly defining moment for a generation.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977. He would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, on the anniversary of his passing. His music continues to move generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's Rock Legacy
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon whose voice and attitude continue to inspire. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a British rock icon, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our kid's another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still an absolute force in British music.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, it's James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the visionary musician and peace activist John Lennon, who was born on this day in 1940. He would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.
